description: T-4446: defined names whose characters XlsxWriter's \w check refuses (spec2xlsx writes them into workbook.xml by hand): a lowercase circled letter, astral squared and negative squared letters, Devanagari with a spacing mark, an uppercase circled letter after the first character, an enclosing or combining mark after the first character, and İ with its decomposed use i+U+0307; plus sheets named Ⓐ, ⓑ, a+U+0301 and x+U+20DD (quoted and unquoted references and their FORMULATEXT), and a cell address followed by a mark (B1+U+0301 defined, B2+U+0301 unbound: names, not references; an R1C1-shaped C1+U+0301 is refused at load). A defined name starting with Ⓐ or a mark, a reference Ⓐ!B1 stored unquoted and a structured reference to a table named Ⓐ are refused at load, so they are not in this case (docs/excel-semantics/references.md "Characters of a name").
